local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local elapsed=0;local period=0;local done=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if core.isWorldPaused() or done then return end
 elapsed=elapsed+dt;period=period+dt;if period<.15 then return end;period=0
 local hp=types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 local npc=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x93ede))
 if not npc or not npc:isValid() then return end
 local reason=nil
 if types.Actor.isDead(self) then reason='player-dead'
 elseif types.Actor.isDead(npc) then reason='target-dead'
 elseif hp<50 then reason='low-health'
 elseif elapsed>35 then reason='timeout' end
 if reason then done=true;print('RendingFight checkpoint='..reason..' health='..hp);print('RendingFight choice=done');return end
 local point=camera.getViewTransform():apply(npc.position+util.vector3(0,0,65))
 local ax=math.atan2(point.x,-point.z);local ay=-math.atan2(point.y,math.sqrt(point.x*point.x+point.z*point.z))
 print(string.format('RendingFight aim x=%d y=%d distance=%.2f playerHP=%.3f targetHP=%.3f',math.max(-80,math.min(80,math.floor(ax*256+.5))),math.max(-40,math.min(40,math.floor(ay*256+.5))),(npc.position-self.position):length(),hp,types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(npc).current))
 print('RendingFight stance='..tostring(types.Actor.getStance(self)))
 print('RendingFight choice=fight')
end}}}}
